title: Interactive studio browser and runtime verification
summary: Verified the staged studio, preview navigation, immediate flashcard review and saved-work restoration; recorded remaining device and performance limits.

changes.detail: New cards are immediately due for review. Browser regression enforces a five-second response.
Browser fixture initializes only the top-frame storage, preserving opaque sandbox isolation; project verification targets the actual feedback.
Recorded staged implementation verification and outstanding native/runtime/performance limitations. No prior reports removed.

validation.name: Browser interactions
validation.detail: All 13 tools discoverable; Real JavaScript grading in app; Wrong implementation fails; AI consent and relevant context; SQLite rows and grading; TypeScript runtime; Actual React initial static rendering; HTML CSS preview; Deterministic math and partial-domain graph; Science calculation; Quiz scoring; Language answer checking; Flashcard creation and scheduling; Whiteboard shapes and progressive explanation; Project refuses unsubstantiated completion; Draft and execution history survive reload; Spaced review survives reload; Whiteboard survives reload; Responsive tool hub at 320,390,900. No page errors. Authentication and AI mocked.

validation.name: Runtime checks
validation.detail: 15 checks: actual JS/TS/SQL/React execution, incorrect solutions, errors, loop interruption, memory bound, isolation, cancellation and script-disabled preview.

validation.name: Automated checks
validation.detail: 300 existing tests passed before the flashcard correction; 12 focused studio/history tests passed afterwards. Post-fix TypeScript and focused ESLint passed; fresh web export passed.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Android/iOS devices, live AI, native Python and target-phone performance unverified. Full React hydration, Next.js server execution, full semantic TypeScript checking and hard Python memory limits remain outside this staged implementation. Export entry approximately 101 MB. Not deployed.
